note: The Essential Pack: the mods CoopIII was built and tested alongside.
CoopIII does not redistribute any of them. Every entry below is fetched
from its own project's download and checked against the hash recorded
here, so what lands in a player's game folder is the file its authors
url and sha256 are deliberately empty. Fill one pair in per component
once you have read that project's licence and are happy to point the
Setup at it; the Setup shows a component with no url but refuses to
install it, rather than pretending it worked.
To get a sha256 for a download:  certutil -hashfile <file> SHA256
